First large gap in this so-called “daily” log!

Actually, I’ve been instead—something I used to enjoy frequently with an old & close friend of mine who I unfortunately haven’t seen in quite a while.

Funny how that works isn’t it?

Inseparable until you’re suddenly moving in separate directions in life. We’ll always pick up like we saw each other yesterday, but I wish it was just yesterday.

We each played our part,

Why we drifted apart,

Don’t know what it’ll take to pick back up,

Just wish we’d start.
